integrity: The theorem is proved analytically for every \(n\ge1\). The checker only replays finite algebraic identities and explicit schedules and is not used as a substitute for the general proof. Literature comparisons distinguish elapsed-time optimality in this restricted architecture from broader gate-synthesis results.
scientific_limitations: Optimality is restricted to one normalized \(Q_n\) interval sandwiched between arbitrary loop-singleton phase layers. Architectures with additional non-diagonal intervals, mixed edge-and-loop graphs, weighted generators, ancillas, negative-time controls, or different Hamiltonian normalizations are not covered.
title: Sharp runtime of the single-hypercube parallel-Hadamard construction
